item.title: Landscape as Witness: A Remembrance reflection
item.description: Take a rare look inside St James' chapel to discover the wartime stories of local people and embrace a moment of calm. Pause in the gardens at our Avenue of Remembrance to reflect on the relationship between landscape, memory and human connection.
item.location: Wentworth Castle Gardens, Barnsley, South Yorkshire

item.title: Little Nature Detectives
item.description: They don’t have to be creepy or crawly - As we start to get cosy for Autumn come and discover which plants and insects make Wentworth Castle Gardens their home during the season.

item.description: Gather your friends and family for an exciting digital adventure for imaginative folk aged 7+ to play together. This Autumn, British folklore sneaks into the real world, set against the backdrop of Wentworth Castle Gardens.
